task.title: Compose selected skills into durable correction tool turns
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/666 by retaining explicit composition and caller-selected parent Attempt lineage across bounded correction continuations.
acceptance_criteria: Reject invalid skill selection and missing or invalid parent Attempt lineage before downstream side effects.
Retain exact policies, selected skills, transcript, prior tool result, task identity, and parent Attempt in an opaque continuation.
Require fresh invocation identity and authorization while preserving metadata-only durable tool evidence.
Persist final provider content as a linked Correction without adding an Attempt or changing terminal task state.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused composed tool task target failed on missing correction-specific outcome and initial and continuation methods.
attempts.patch: Added tests for exact authority and result retention, linked Correction persistence, selection and lineage preflight, durable invocation evidence, and stale transcript rejection.

attempts.diagnostic: Correction-specific outcomes could retain caller-owned parent lineage while shared private observation helpers kept attempt and correction provider and tool sequencing DRY.
attempts.patch: Added correction outcomes and entrypoints, generalized observation routing, documented correction ordering and compatibility, and updated the ADR and milestone.

attempts.summary: Strengthened the exact continuation contract before review.
attempts.diagnostic: Independent review found stale ADR wording and insufficiently exact assertions for the prior in-memory tool result and invocation evidence.
attempts.patch: Corrected the ADR, strengthened exact result and invocation assertions, reran pinned verification, and completed substantive exact-head review with no unresolved threads.

outcome.summary: Durable correction tool turns now preserve selected-skill authority and exact parent Attempt lineage across explicit continuations before appending linked Correction evidence.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30303716303 and substantive exact-head CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/667

lessons: Correction lineage is caller-owned context and must survive every non-terminal provider and tool step unchanged.
A final correction is linked evidence, not a new Attempt or a task lifecycle transition.
Selection and lineage checks belong before provider, tool, and durable side effects, while stale transcript checks protect continuation replay.
Shared observation helpers can remove sequencing duplication without erasing distinct Attempt and Correction persistence semantics.
Exact prior-result and invocation assertions are needed to prove an opaque continuation did not substitute data.
